question: True or false: in onChange={e => setName(e.currentTarget.value)}, you must type e yourself.
say: True or false: in an inline on change arrow function, you must type the event yourself.
explanation: False. When the handler is written inline, TypeScript infers the event type from the onChange prop. You only annotate extracted handlers.
explainSay: False. Inline handlers get their event type inferred from the prop.
